title: Evaluate retrieval quality before promoting memory changes
goal: Use a versioned relevance and grounded-answer suite to compare retrieval/index revisions; a larger index or higher recall alone cannot hide regression in answer correctness or private-data isolation. Deps (vectors): VC-201-001, VC-201-081. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_082_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
